en: But... the ritual is necessary. Surely, they can't just...
Everyone deserves hope and comfort, even the forsaken souls of this island. That is why we came here, as missionaries to bring hope to those who have none.
Excellent. I am Dame Constance Borgnina, a crusader in the service of the Holy Lord, and I have come to this island of my own volition, as a sort of pilgrimage.
Forget the ritual, then. They've managed for years, and they'll continue to manage without me.
Go quickly, and try not to rouse suspicion. I don't know how long I can keep the sisters confined to this room.
Have you reconsidered? Will you help me to save the sisters?
I felt the energy shift when you placed the last jewel. Good work. Now, all that remains is for me to make the final incantations.

I have come to this parish only recently, and what I have seen here disturbs me. The sisters, like me, have come here in pilgrimage, long ago, but in their time spent here, something is... changing them.

I have prepared a ritual that can purge the corruption from the sisters, and from the abbey, but if I enact it on my own, it will alert them to my suspicion, and they may try to disrupt it or to flee. Instead, I will have you perform the preparations, while I make sure the sisters remain within this room.
I see. Perhaps once you've rested and had a look around, you will hear what I have to say. Come and find me later.
I will wait until you are clear before I begin. Thank you again.
If you have other matters to attend to, I understand, but without your help I may need to resort to more drastic measures. Please come and find me if you change your mind.

It is an interesting time for this island. The prisons can't possibly contain everybody, and something is sure to rise out of all of the chaos. We will try to guide the lost through the confusion the best we can.

It isn't right, is it? I wanted... needed there to be demons, needed some kind of evil that I could fight, but... they're just human beings cut off from the rest of the world. Human beings with human vices.
My gut is telling me that something is wrong here. There is something lending a corrupting influence, and I owe it to my sisters to find it and stop it. In this, I need your help.
Please go. You haven't sworn the oaths to this order, so there is no need for you to suffer the purge.
Sisters! In the name of God, we shall purge this evil from our world! Come!
Strangers? Mayhap my prayers have been answered. Thank God. May we talk?

Take these, and position them outside the corners of the abbey, or as close to the corners as you can manage. Once they are in place, I can complete the ritual, and all corruption within the abbey will be purged. The sisters will be saved.
Their behaviors are strange and lax, rituals are forgotten or distorted, and they've given in to petty vanities that are beneath a sister of the order.
There... is nothing of note here, and I would prefer not to linger. Do what you must, and then let us move on.
We don't get word from the mainland way out here. Have you any word of how things are in Crest?
We don't have much to offer you, but any of us would be glad to lend an ear for your troubles.
We hadn't had visitors for a very long time, and then we have both Dame Borgnina and you within a few days. It's a busy time, I suppose.
Welcome to the abbey, dear. If you are weary, our doors are open to you. Come and rest.
What have I become?
Will you help me stop the corruption that is preying upon my sisters?
Yes. There is... much to be done. I mustn't linger. Farewell, sister.
You had best leave now. The purging will be... painful, and you should not be subject to it.
You've returned. Will you hear what I have to say?
You, Maledicus, would dare to set foot in a house of God? I am his agent, and I shall be your shepherd! Meet him for true and be judged!
...Paul...
Alright. Those injuries are bad, but that should help him make it back to the stronghold.
Bato!
Bato! Paul! Are you alright?!
Bato!!
Come on buddy, wait for me!
Get your greasy claws off of me you stinking buzzards!
He's hurt bad, but he's alive! Looks like he managed to hang on to that harpy for most of the drop.
How are you feeling, Paul? You don't look so good.
I'm fine. I'll have time to hurt after he's tucked into a healer's tent.
If you hadn't jumped, we'd have lost Bato for sure. It was stupid, but you saved his life. I'm sure he'll thank you when he's awake.
It's weird, isn't it? You can sort of feel it. The urge to just throw yourself off. If a man was already losing himself in sorrow, I can imagine how it might pull you over.
Look at all the grave markers. This place gives me the creeps.
Ngh! Hang on, Bato!
Shit! Harpies!
Shit, Paul! What are you doing?!
That's not happening boss, sorry.
We don't have to stay long. Let's just see if we can spot anything along the coastline, and then get out.
We'll get some rope! Just stay there and don't move!
We're too far out to even get a decent view of anything. I think this plan was a wash.
You better not leave me, Bato. You better not!
You should let someone else carry him. Give your body some rest.
-but you aren't alone. You don't have to fight alone, you don't have to mourn alone, and you don't have to suffer alone.
...have any good reason to refuse. Lead the way.
All clear. It's no luxury, but it's dry at least.
An accidental touch. A look that's a little too long, a smile that's a little too warm. You shared those things, I know you did.
And I would spend my nights staring at the ceiling, or watching his breath pass his lips, wishing that I could ...
Are you out there, Max?
As I'm sure you might imagine.
As it turns out, I wasn't even a worthy sacrifice. I prevented nothing, and I have nothing.
Aye, and I don't fancy trailing through the darkness holding hands, either. We should turn back.
Certainly, just let me fetch my clothes.
Do you really think he didn't know? You wear your heart so far down your sleeve, I'm surprised it doesn't fall into your breakfast.
Drag me off and tear me to ribbons if it pleases you. I no longer care.
Hah. Damn you for making so much sense, Brunok.
He knew full well that you loved him. How could he not? He kept you as close as he did because he loved you just the same, and he never said anything for the same damned reasons you just told me.
He was my cousin's husband! I would never-!
I am right here. Talk to me.
I can find my way by scent, but I guess that doesn't help you guys.
I didn't walk into that prison willingly for my cousin, I did it for him, so that the people would have their blood, and his would be spared.
I do.
I don't really think I...
I get a lot of requests for that lately.
I had a feeling. Shall we, then?
I suppose we all look the same to you?
I understand you loved him, Luc. I can hear your heart breaking every time we walk past one of those damned statues.
I was supposed to die fat and full of ale, not waging war in the ruins of my homeland.
I'm so lost, Max. I don't know what to do. I wish you were here.
Id varum! It's dark, how was I supposed to know it was you!?
If his memory is so precious, you need to stop dragging it around and wear it proudly. It's what he would want, isn't it?
Irum noct! Id Jamd'katch!
It would have been a betrayal of my country, my queen, and our friendship, and so I never spoke my heart.
It's a warm night and the rest of us are already naked. You'll make us feel awkward. Come on, it can be a new experience.
It's okay guys, he's with me. You can go back, I'll catch up.
Just forget about it.
Luc, I'm sorry. The world moved on while you stood still and I know that you feel lost and confused and alone-
Luc, what are you doing out here?
Luc, you spend so much time talking to ghosts. Try talking to flesh and blood for a change.
Luc, you're an idiot.
Me and my boys killed a deer. Help us butcher it, and it's venison for breakfast.
No?
Right this way.
So, you like to hunt, right?
That's an awful thing to say.
That's fine, Grant, we don't need luxury. Not a moment to spare.
There's a very old hunter's camp nearby, if my memory serves. I can find it, and we probably have enough twilight to make it there without tripping over each other.
Venison for breakfast is one of my favorite pleasures.
Venison for breakfast!
We don't have a lot of time to figure out an alternative. Lead the way, Grant.
We shouldn't have set out so late. We're going to get lost in this place for sure. Worse than lost if we run into something dangerous.
We used to go hunting together. Him and I and a few other lads from the capital.
We would go out to his lodge and spend days hunting and drinking and laughing.
Well, my country, my queen, and my friend, they're all gone, hundreds of years dust, and I've nothing but a regretful, broken heart that should be rotting alongside them.
What's all this about tearing you to ribbons, then?
Why is it me? This sort of strange journey is the stuff meant for heroes like you.
You wouldn't understand.
You're such a straight stick, I actually believe that you would never, but that doesn't mean you never wanted to.
You... how do you..?
Turn back!
You, stranger, honour us with your offering. In return, we shall teach you to hunt as we hunt. Your prey will know no peace.
Bato was nearly eaten by them when we first arrived on the island.
But you're bigger than they are. Fighting something bigger than you sucks. I'd know.
Come on, Bato. We'll be fine.
Could you guys focus please? Treasure now, compensation later.
I don't, because I'm not a coward!
I see. Well, don't worry, Bato. Just stand behind me and I'll cut them down.
I smell them too. Ugh, it's actually really bad now that you mention it.
I think I just juiced in my shorts a little. Would you say
I'll be right behind you.
Is that what that smell is? Huh.
Let them come. I'll slaughter every last one of them.
Oh no, no no no! This place smells like sahaguin! They're waiting under the water, I just know it!
Oh, screw you, Harpy! Like you don't have anything you're afraid of!
Okay. Okay, Bato, you can do this. Hands on your weapon, head in the game.
Remarkable! It looks like the place swallowed up the wrecks of a dozen ships. Who knows what treasures might be inside?
Shouldn't cowards like you be back at the stronghold washing our clothes? You'll just get in the way, and we're better off without you.
Son, if we get a crate of Tsarathi whiskey out of this, I'll go as deep as you want.
That's enough, you two!
We're not going to let anything hurt you, Bato. Relax.
Well that is rather unpleasant. After all that work we went through to get this gate open, I hope there's something worthwhile to find.
You guys heard him say that, right?
You're afraid of sahaguin?
You're not wrong. There are sahaguin here, and they will find a way to ambush us before we're done with this place.
a few more times for me, Captain? A little deeper and slower, please.
A boat? You're as bad as old Logus.
A good day to you travellers. Welcome to The Shipyard.
Ah well. Logus had some good stories, but he wasn't much help around town, to be honest. We'll manage without him.
Come to listen to an old sailor flap his tusks? Have a seat, maybe something will come to mind.
Everyone except Logus anyway.
Except for those of us doing maintenance, all of the boys are out logging, hunting, and securing the roads right now.
Good day to you, Captain.
Good to see you, Captain. Will your friends be needing a place to stay the night?
He hasn't come back. I hope he's alright.
He's around here somewhere. Maybe you should talk to him about it.
I get that he's sentimental for his seafaring days, but that guy has got to learn to let go. We're Lukattites now, like it or not. Gotta make the best of it.
I guess I won't be coming back here for a while. Let me just grab some of my things.
I lost my sea legs a long time ago, so don't go asking me about boats and all. I get enough of that nonsense from Logus as it is.
I see. Well do take care of yourselves.
I'll go right now and start making preparations. You do anything else you need to do and then come find me, and we'll leave this blasted rock behind for good.
I'll keep an ear out for supplies in the meantime, but I can't really set anything up until I know we've got a crew. If you're serious about this, then get on it.

I'll tell you what. You put together a crew, and I'll get the boat. We'll sail anywhere you want to go. We'll leave this cold little rock behind and we'll be free men again. If you've got the guts, of course.
I'm guessing that anybody you find here isn't going to be an experienced sailor, so let's say... twenty. You put together a band of twenty strong backs, and we'll have enough to man the ship.
I've found a lot of shipbuilding supplies so far, but that don't do us any good. I wanted to sell them to some travelling merchants, but Logus put up a giant stink and insisted we keep them.
I've heard that before. I'll stick to saving us from hunger and exposure, thanks.

If you're looking for curatives, I can mix you up an elixir. For fair coin, of course.
Let's say 150$
Is Logus really gone? I hope I can sell those supplies before he comes back. The extra trade would do us all some good.
Is Logus really gone? It seems so quiet now.
Logus just sits and mopes for months on end and then just like that he packs his things and saunters out the gate. He looked pretty happy too.
Logus left, looking pleased as can be. You didn't have something to do with that, did you?
No, but thanks for the offer. We'll be off again shortly.
Not for long. Just here for some business and then we're off again.

Not that I have much faith you'll manage that. I've tried to put together crews before. Always someone putting a knife in someone's back, someone losing their nerve. If you get enough men, come find me, but if not, don't get my hopes up.
Oh, Logus, you're back.
Perfect. Just give me a minute.
Right. Well, don't let me keep you then.
Sorry, I have to focus on my work for the shipyard now. Maybe the trader has something that can help you.
Sorry, but that won't cut it. Can't give my work away for free.
Still working on that crew I see. Look, I ain't gonna be picky. Men or orcs or giants or golems for all I care, makes no difference. I just need twenty people who can take orders.
There are so many crates in these warehouses, we still don't know what's inside all of them.
There you go. I hope it helps.
There's a place a little distance west of here along the north shore called Forfshire Bay. Used to be a pirates' holdout as I understand.
There's no need to be that cruel, now is there?

There's still a ship there, a seaworthy one, tucked away in a grotto. I've been out to it several times, so I know it well. I set up a little security you see, so that nobody would be able to find it.
These huts might not look very impressive, but they're all we've got. Our boys are gonna be tired when they get home, so I'm making sure that everything stays tight and standing.
This place isn't really a shipyard anymore, alright? We live in the old warehouses and all, but we don't build ships or anything. I don't think any of us would even know how.
Traitor
Trying to save us all. Someone's got to.
Well I'll be damned. I think that just might be enough manpower to pull this off. I didn't want to get my hopes up, but there you went and kicked the stool out from under me.
What are you up to now, Logus?
You want to leave this rotten island? There isn't a boat here, but... I do know where there is one.
You'd be surprised how busy the boys here keep me. There's always someone with a scrape or a gouge or a pulled hamstring.
Your loss then. Can't give my work away for free.
, would you? I can't even remember the last time I dug a rut.
A whore house! I kinda thought it would feel more fun than this. It's really sort of depressing, isn't it?
Ah, well that is a shame, but if you are not interested, I must ask you to leave. Leave the door open, if you please.
And I'll thank you kindly. You enjoy yourselves, hear?
Anyway, I got a bit of lard, and...well, tear my ass up, I guess! Get your money's worth.
Are you here to see Ms. Anna? She's wonderful. Really wonderful. I can't wait to see her again.

Are you surprised that this isn't an alehouse? It was once, to be sure, but we've managed to repurpose it. I can't say for a certainty that we're the only brothel on the island, but I don't know of another.
Clear objectives! I can work with that!
Cute. I can count, idiot. You come back with more coin, or I have Ray and Bo teach you some manners.
Damn, that Mercedes is a screamer. I should've made my appointment with her instead of Anna. Now I feel stupid.
Did you indeed? Good information to have.
Do you imagine that it would be worth it?
Do you think there are any humans or orcs who would have sex with a goblin? I wonder what that would be like.
Don't go makin' trouble now, hear?
Don't say such awful things. You're beautiful too. Just look at this... and this here. And that too. It's all beautiful. You're beautiful. Why don't you just relax and let me appreciate you?
Filthy peasant! A lady of my calibre is worth at least twice that much! Also, fuck you.
Good to see someone managing to make a business of this place, isn't it? I never did understand why places like this were illegal.
Guess I'd be a lot richer if I was pretty enough to be a whore.
Guess my girl was right about that much.
Guests in The Breakfast Room will receive room service first thing in the morning. Until then, relax and enjoy your evening!
Hah! What a splendid cover. Do you suppose they have soaps and a bath here? I haven't washed my  hair properly in far too long.
Have you had a look around? It's quite a lovely place, isn't it?
Hello. Have you come to listen to Braisa weave the air into music?
Hey asshole, get your pet away from me before I put a fist through it.
Hi again. Can't do you another juicing, sorry. Take on too much side work and I get in trouble. I'm sure you understand.
